opening.argument: The promotion promises tremendous profit and describes a brand-new cryptocurrency as going viral, with over 200,000 members mining it and its value rising every day, week after week. It reinforces that appeal with the claim that “literally people's lives are being changed every single day,” then urges viewers to contact the person who shared the message to learn how to profit and avoid missing the trend. The description identifies the opportunity as OneCoin and provides a direct joining URL. Together, these wealth claims, popularity and rising-value assertions, urgency, and direct route to join make this an active solicitation to participate, not neutral commentary. The supplied material does not show a completed payment or loss; the concern is that unsupported claims are used to encourage participation.
